title: Provisioning, asset classification and income recognition (IRACP) and the ECL readiness controls

automated_npa_classification.description: Core-banking module that classifies every borrowal account at day-end, with straight-through upgrades and downgrades.

sma_tagging.description: Tags overdue accounts as SMA-0, SMA-1 or SMA-2 in the day-end process, with the date of tagging.

overdue_flagging.description: Flags an account overdue in the day-end process for the due date, whatever time the process runs.

standard_asset_provisioning.description: Computes the general provision on standard assets at 0.25 per cent (housing, farm credit, small and micro enterprises) or 0.40 per cent.

npa_provisioning.description: Computes substandard (15% / 25% unsecured), doubtful (100% unsecured plus 25/40/100% secured by age) and loss (100%) provisions.

resolution_plan_provisioning.description: Books the additional specific provision of 5 per cent of the outstanding for each resolution plan implemented.
synonyms: additional provision for resolution plans (5% per plan)

cash_basis_income_recognition.description: Stops interest accrual on non-standard accounts and recognises income on receipt; re-restructured accounts are on cash basis.
synonyms: income recognition on cash basis for npas

interest_reversal.description: Reverses uncollected interest on an account that turns NPA and tracks it in a memorandum account.
synonyms: interest reversal and memorandum account on npa

classification_override_governance.description: Overrides of system classification need two-level authorisation, a system-generated log kept three years, and Audit Committee reporting.
synonyms: manual override log with dual authorisation

npa_system_audit.description: Yearly audit of the classification system parameters and of compliance with the IRACP norms.
synonyms: annual system audit of the npa classification system

npa_mis_reporting.description: System-generated segment-wise NPA, provisions, write-offs and restructured assets, reconciled to regulatory returns.
synonyms: segment-wise npa and restructured asset mis

crilc_reporting.description: Reports large credits and SMA accounts to CRILC and files the supervisory returns on time.

collateral_valuation_stock_audit.description: Annual external stock audit and three-yearly valuation of immovable collateral for NPAs of INR 5 crore and above.
synonyms: collateral valuation and stock audit for npas of inr 5 crore and above

borrower_education_sma_npa.description: Website literature and branch posters on overdue, SMA and NPA; front-line briefing at sanction.
synonyms: borrower education on sma and npa

credit_limit_review_tracking.description: Tracks regular and ad hoc limits so that reviews finish within three months and no limit goes 180 days unreviewed.
synonyms: credit limit review and renewal tracker

floating_provision_governance.description: Board-approved ceiling and extraordinary-circumstance criteria; RBI approval before any utilisation.

resolution_plan_register.description: Flags accounts under a resolution plan, counts restructuring instances and keeps them standard per 62A/62B.
synonyms: resolution plan register and restructuring flagging

crop_season_npa_calendar.description: Applies the two-crop-season (short duration) and one-crop-season (long duration) norms with SLBC calendars.
synonyms: crop-season npa calendar for agricultural advances

loan_agreement_due_date_disclosure.description: Loan agreements state due dates, frequency, principal and interest split and example SMA/NPA dates.
synonyms: loan agreement due-date and sma/npa date disclosure

board_iracp_policy.description: Board policy covering income recognition, floating provisions, higher standard-asset provisioning, valuers and delegation for overrides.

kyc_risk_categorisation.description: Assigns low, medium or high risk at onboarding and at review.

kyc_periodic_updation.description: Re-KYC every 2 years (high risk), 8 years (medium) and 10 years (low), with reminders from 60 days before the due date.

aml_transaction_monitoring.description: Scenario-based monitoring on the deposit and card books; loan repayments are not yet covered.

grievance_redressal_tracking.description: Registers, routes and ages complaints; escalates to the internal ombudsman and tracks Ombudsman references.

fair_practices_disclosure.description: Checks that loan applications, sanction letters and charge disclosures follow the Fair Practices Code.

recovery_agent_conduct.description: Code of conduct, call-hour limits and complaint review for recovery agents; call recording covers 60 per cent of agencies.

outsourcing_due_diligence.description: Register of material outsourcing, due diligence, access for supervisors and exit plans.
synonyms: outsourced service provider register and due diligence

document_custody_register.description: Records every original property document by loan, location and movement; feeds the 30-day release tracker.

credit_appraisal_delegation.description: Appraisal checklist, cash-flow-based repayment schedules and sanction within delegated limits.
synonyms: credit appraisal and delegation of powers checks

regulatory_change_tracking.description: Compliance logs RBI circulars and assigns owners; impact assessment is manual and takes weeks.

ecl_staging.description: Assigns every instrument to Stage 1, 2 or 3 at each reporting date, with SICR triggers.

sicr_criteria_documentation.description: Documented, consistently applied criteria for a significant increase in credit risk, with the 30-day rebuttable presumption.

probability_of_default_model.description: 12-month and lifetime PD by segment, with the regulatory floor of 0.03 per cent.

loss_given_default_model.description: LGD from own recovery history, with the prescribed LGD where history is insufficient.

exposure_at_default_model.description: EAD including drawdown expectations on commitments and guarantees.

effective_interest_rate_computation.description: EIR at initial recognition, fee and cost amortisation, interest income on gross carrying amount.

macroeconomic_scenarios.description: Multiple macro scenarios with probability weights, linked to PD and LGD.

ecl_model_validation.description: Independent pre-implementation validation, back-testing and calibration of ECL models.

prudential_floor_calculation.description: Product-wise and stage-wise floors on the ECL allowance, with strict product category segregation.

ecl_model_inventory.description: Inventory of all models in the ECL lifecycle with risk-based tiering and documentation.
synonyms: ecl model inventory and risk tiering

historical_loss_database.description: Sufficient history of defaults, recoveries and loss to calibrate PD and LGD.

ecl_transition_fair_valuation.description: Fair valuation of the loan portfolio on 1 Apr 2027 and the CET1 transition adjustment.
synonyms: fair valuation on transition and transitional arrangements

ecl_board_governance.description: Board policy and a committee with the CFO and CRO that oversees ECL implementation.
synonyms: board ecl oversight (committee with cfo and cro)

ecl_disclosure_reporting.description: Annex 4 disclosures and the first ECL reporting as at 30 Jun 2027.

third_party_model_governance.description: Selection, validation and contractual access for models bought from vendors.

ecl_model_monitoring.description: Ongoing performance monitoring with clear responsibilities and frequency.

record_flags.restructured: A resolution plan has been implemented on the loan (IRACP paras 62A, 62B, 84A-84D, 139A, 139B).
record_flags.secured: The exposure was secured ab initio: security above 10 per cent of the outstanding (IRACP para 5(13)).

vw_asset_quality.description: One row per ACTIVE loan with its asset classification, security, provisioning and interest recognition. Opaque refs only; no names or contact details.

columns.days_past_due: int: days past due, counting the due date as day 1
columns.asset_classification: enum[STANDARD|SMA0|SMA1|SMA2|SUBSTANDARD|DOUBTFUL|LOSS]: asset classification recorded by the bank's day-end process
columns.npa_date: date: date the account was classified NPA, null for standard accounts
columns.npa_age_months: int: completed months since npa_date, null for standard accounts (below 12 is substandard, 12 or more doubtful)
columns.security_value: int: INR assessed realisable value of the security
columns.secured: bool: true when the exposure was secured ab initio (security above 10 per cent of the outstanding, para 5(13))
columns.secured_portion: int: INR part of the outstanding covered by the security
columns.unsecured_portion: int: INR part of the outstanding not covered by the security
columns.restructured: bool: a resolution plan has been implemented
columns.restructure_date: date: date of the latest resolution plan
columns.restructure_count: int: number of resolution plans (restructuring instances) implemented
columns.provision_held: int: INR provision held against the account
columns.provision_required: int: INR provision the bank's system computed as required under IRACP
columns.interest_recognition: enum[ACCRUAL|CASH]: basis on which interest income is recognised
columns.ecl_stage_proxy: int: PROXY ONLY, derived from days past due (1 up to 30, 2 up to 90, 3 above); not the output of an ECL staging engine

vw_kyc_status.description: One row per customer with the periodic KYC updation status. Opaque customer reference only.

columns.kyc_risk_category: enum[LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH]: customer risk category (re-KYC every 10, 8 or 2 years)
columns.last_kyc_review: date: date of the last KYC review
columns.kyc_due_date: date: date by which the next KYC updation is due
columns.kyc_status: enum[CURRENT|DUE_SOON|OVERDUE]: DUE_SOON within 60 days of the due date, OVERDUE after it
